question: Yogesh Gaur, who died in May 2020, is known for his contribution in the field of:
solution:
The correct answer is__** music.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Yogesh Gaur **generally known as Yogesh was an Indian **author and lyricist.**
 
• He was famous for his benefaction to Bollywood, and mainly his best-known works came from the **film Anand, songs** comprising **Kahin Door Jab Din Dal Jaaye **and **Zindagi Kaisi Hai Paheli (1971)**, and as well as **Rajnigandha Phool tumhare **coming from the movie **Rajnigandha (1974).**
 
• Yogesh as well served in television serials as an author.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b5b07cba63ce285aea4442b99545e67f055c1f5a167c9d465257a7fddb88059.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The author and musician Yogesh Gaur was born on 19 March 1943 in Lucknow.
 
• Yogesh as well contracted with **Basu Chatterji, **one more master filmmaker, and wrote for him in films such as **Us Paar (1974), Rajnigandha (1974), Priyatama (1977), Baato Baato Mein (1979) and Apne Paraye (1980) in the middle of others.**​
